name: Credit Transfer Mandate
definition: Authorisation in favour of the creditor agent given by the creditor to initiate a credit transfer from its own account.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for the setup of the credit transfer mandate.

FirstPaymentDate.name: First Payment Date
FirstPaymentDate.definition: Date of the first payment of a recurrent credit transfer as per the mandate.

DateOfVerification.name: Date Of Verification
DateOfVerification.definition: Date on which the credit transfer mandate has been verified.

FinalPaymentDate.name: Final Payment Date
FinalPaymentDate.definition: Date of the final payment of a recurrent credit transfer as per the mandate.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.definition: Additional security provisions, such as a digital signature, as provided by the debtor.
